method: Frozen 1.7.5 and 1.7.4 effect implementations in the same current renderer; seed 812, 21 held living snakes, mass 48, 850 food, Shibuya, DPR 1; ABBA. Initial 2s warm / 3.5s sample, flagged same-camera repeats 4s warm / 6s sample, supplemental fixed-camera impact repeats. Values are arithmetic means of two run medians/p95s, not pooled quantiles. GPU uses sparse nonblocking timer queries. All measurements retained.
